raw_comment: I noticed that there are extremely limited areas where there wasn't any drought. I also noticed how Florida didn't have any drought at all. I wonder if the graph calculates clean-drinking water in terms of drought or just no rainfall. This relates to our community because we haven't had a lot of rain and had a lot of forest fires. "Areas affected by Wide-Spread Drought: And It's not Florida's fault"
